name: BNL-E-0427
summary: BNL E427 used the seven-foot bubble chamber to measure neutrino scattering on protons and neutrons, supplying important low-energy nucleon cross-section and hadronic-final-state data.
physics_targets: Charged-current neutrino-proton and neutrino-neutron cross sections
detection_principle: Charged secondaries from neutrino interactions left visible bubble tracks in liquid deuterium. Magnetic curvature and topology allowed muons, protons, pions and strange-particle decays to be reconstructed, with quasi-elastic events helping normalize the flux.
